info.title: bia
info.description: Workflows as data, run from Postgres. Every endpoint fails with the same error body: a stable `code`, a `message`, and `diagnostics` when a Definition was at fault.

get.summary: Answers while the process serves HTTP, whatever the state of the database.

post.summary:
Starts a Run of the Workflow's Active Version from one of its webhook Triggers, with the
JSON body (`{}` when empty) as `input`, checked against the `input_schema`. A Trigger without
`hmac` needs its bound `webhook` Token or an `admin` Token as `Authorization: Bearer`; one
with `hmac` needs the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, as hex optionally prefixed `sha256=`, in
its `hmac.header`. Without a Token, a path that names no webhook Trigger of an Active Version
answers `missing_token`, like a Trigger that needs one.

`invalid_token`.

403.description: The Token's Scope does not allow this route; `code` is `insufficient_scope`.

404.description: `webhook_not_found`, to a caller with a Token.

post.summary:
Asks for the Run to stop. The response is 202: a Worker cancels the Attempt in flight and
the Run becomes `cancelled` a moment later (a sleeping Run at once), which `get_run` shows.
A Run that already finished is refused with `run_finished`.

post.summary:
Resumes a `failed` Run from the Step that failed, on its own Version even if another is
active now. Steps that succeeded do not run again; the failed Step gets a fresh retry
budget and its Attempt numbers carry on. A Run that is not `failed`, or failed before any
Step ran (e.g. invalid input), is refused with `run_not_resumable`.

post.summary:
Starts a new Run with the input and Version of a finished Run. The new Run's `trigger` is
the original's plus `retry_of`, the original's id. Re-running on a newer Version means
triggering the Workflow instead. A Run that has not finished is refused with
`run_not_finished`.

post.summary:
Mints the first admin Token of a fresh install, authenticated with the server's bootstrap
key (`BIA_BOOTSTRAP_KEY`) instead of a Token. It refuses once an unrevoked admin Token
exists, so the key cannot mint a second one; `bia token create --bootstrap` calls it.

401.description: No bootstrap key, or the wrong one; `code` is `missing_token` or `invalid_token`.

403.description: `bootstrap_disabled`: the server has no bootstrap key.

post.summary:
Starts a Run of the Workflow's Active Version from a manual Trigger. The input is checked
against the Version's `input_schema` first: input that does not match is refused with
`invalid_run_input`, and no Run is created. The Run is `pending` in the response and a
Worker picks it up. A Workflow with no Active Version is refused with `no_active_version`,
and one whose Active Version has no manual Trigger (or not the named one) with
`no_manual_trigger`.

post.summary:
Saves the request body, a Definition, as a new Draft of the Workflow, numbered after its
latest Version. The Workflow is created by its first Draft. Any number of Drafts may exist
at once. Semantic errors do not stop a Draft from being saved: they come back in
`diagnostics`. A body that does not parse as a Definition is refused with
`invalid_definition`, and one whose `id` is not the Workflow's with `workflow_id_mismatch`.

post.summary:
Makes a Published Version the Workflow's Active Version: new Runs start on it and the
scheduler follows its cron Triggers. Activating an older Version is a rollback; Runs
already started keep their Version (ADR-0009). Needs an `admin` Token.

post.summary:
Dry-runs a stored Version, a Draft or a Published one: pure Actions run for real, side
effects return Mocks, and waits resolve instantly. Nothing is stored and nothing outside
the server is touched. The Definition must have no error Diagnostics (`invalid_definition`
otherwise); a Mock that names a missing or unMockable Step, or is not in the documented
format, is refused with `invalid_mock`.

requestBody.description: The input and Mocks; send `{}` for none.

post.summary:
Publishes a Draft after validating it for publishing: unknown Queues and Workflows and
disabled or dangerous Actions are errors, and any error refuses with `invalid_definition`
and the Diagnostics. A Published Version never changes again. Needs an `admin` Token, which
is also what keeps Versions that use dangerous Actions in human hands.

ActionEffect.description:
Whether an Action can change anything outside the Run. A Dry Run executes `pure` Actions
and gives `side_effecting` ones a Mock.

ActionEntry.description: An Action a Step can name in `action`.

dangerous.description: Disabled unless enabled in server config, and only publishable with an `admin` Token.

enabled.description: A Version that uses a disabled Action cannot be published.

examples.description: Example calls, also the source of Mocks in a Dry Run.

output_schema.description: The JSON Schema of the Step's Output, read by later Steps as `steps.<id>.output`.

param_schema.description: The JSON Schema a Step's `params` must satisfy once its Templates are resolved.

name.description: What the Token is for, e.g. `admin`.

CreatedToken.description: A Token just created, with its value.

value.description:
Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <value>`. Shown only in this response: bia keeps a
hash of it, so a lost value cannot be recovered, only replaced.

DefinitionDryRunRequest.description: What a Dry Run of a Definition that need not be stored takes.

definition.description: A Definition (see `GET /v1/schema`). Its Workflow need not exist.

Diagnostic.description: One validation finding about a Definition.

code.description: A stable snake_case phrase naming the problem, listed in `docs/dsl.md`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Its wording may change; match on `code`.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the offending value, e.g. `/steps/0/params/url`.

suggestion.description: A likely fix, such as the nearest known name.

diagnostics.description: Validation findings that are not errors, such as problems only publishing needs solved.

dry_run.description: Always `true`; marks the Timeline as not a real Run's.

timeline.description:
The entries a real Run's Timeline would hold, in the same shape and order. Waits take
no real time, but their entries show the time they would have taken.

DryRunRequest.description: What a Dry Run of a stored Version takes.

input.description:
The Run input. Defaults to `{}`. Checked against the Definition's `input_schema`, as a
real Run's is.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

diagnostics.description: The Diagnostics behind the error, in document order. Absent when none apply.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Its wording may change; match on `code`.

ErrorCode.description:
A stable identifier for what went wrong with a request. Agents match on it, so codes may be
added, but renaming or removing one needs an ADR (ADR-0042).

FailedRun.description: A failed Run and the entry that failed it.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to get the next page. Absent on the last page.

MockSchema.description:
What a Step returns in a Dry Run instead of calling its Action. Give exactly one of
`output`, `error` or `attempts`.

Without a Mock, a `pure` Action runs for real and a `side_effecting` one returns the
Output of its first example, or, having no example, fails with the `no_mock` code. A Mock
also applies to a `pure` Action, which lets a Dry Run force it to fail. Only Steps that
call an Action can be Mocked: not `flow.*` Steps or Blocks.

attempts.description:
One `{ "output" }` or `{ "error" }` per Attempt: the first Attempt gets the first, and
the last repeats for the Attempts after it. Use it to fail twice and then succeed.

error.description:
The error every Attempt fails with: `{ "class": "retryable" | "fatal", "message",
"details"? }`. A `retryable` error follows the Step's retry policy exactly as a real one
does.

output.description: The Output every Attempt returns. Any JSON value, `null` included.

name.description: What the Token is for, e.g. `claude-desktop`. Need not be unique.

oneOf.description: Required with the `webhook` Scope, and refused with any other.

PutSecretRequest.description: The value of a Secret, to store.

value.description: Encrypted before it is stored and never returned by any route. At least one character.

timeline.description:
Every entry so far, oldest first: one per Attempt, with its inputs, Output or error and
duration.

RunInfo.description: A Run with its input and its Timeline.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to get the next page. Absent on the last page.

RunSummary.description: A Run without its input and Timeline, as listed.

cancel_requested_at.description:
When cancellation was requested. A Run with this set that has not finished is still
being stopped.

finished_at.description: Absent until the Run is `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`.

retry_of.description: The Run this one is a retry of. Absent unless the Run was started by `retry_run`.

trigger.description:
What started the Run: `{ "type": "manual", "id": <Trigger id> }`, `{ "type": "cron", ... }`
and so on. A retried Run carries its original's `trigger` plus `retry_of`.

version.description: The Version the Run is pinned to for its whole life, even if another becomes active.

SavedVersion.description: A Version just saved or published, with what validation found.

diagnostics.description:
Every Diagnostic for the Definition. A Draft may be saved with errors; publishing
requires none.

SchemaDocument.description: The DSL's JSON Schemas and the Action catalogue.

actions.description: Every Action this server knows, disabled ones included, ordered by name.

definition.description:
The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) a Definition must satisfy. Passing it is the first
layer of validation; Diagnostics report the rest.

queue.description: The JSON Schema of a `kind: queue` resource file.

updated_at.description: When the value was last set.

TargetName.description: What a Definition is validated for.

TimelineEntryInfo.description:
One entry of a Run's Timeline: an Attempt of a Step, or, without `step_id`, something that
happened to the Run as a whole, such as input rejected before any Step ran.

attempt.description:
Counts up across the Attempts of a Step, from 1, also across a resume. Absent without
`step_id`.

error.description:
`{ "class": "retryable" | "fatal", "message", "details"?, "code"? }`. `code` is a stable
identifier when bia itself raised the error, e.g. `invalid_input` or `timeout`.

input.description:
The Params with their Templates resolved, except that any Template reading `secrets`
is shown as written; for an entry about the Run, the Run input.

iteration_path.description: Which iteration of the enclosing loops, empty outside loops. Absent without `step_id`.

seq.description: Position in the Timeline, starting at 1. Entries are ordered by it.

last_used_at.description: When the Token last authenticated a request, to the minute.

revoked_at.description: Once set, the Token authenticates nothing.

tokens.description: Every Token, revoked ones included, oldest first.

input.description: The Run input. Defaults to `{}`. Checked against the Active Version's `input_schema`.

trigger_id.description:
The manual Trigger to start from. Defaults to the first manual Trigger of the Active
Version.

valid.description:
Whether the Definition has no error Diagnostics, so it can be published (for the
`publish` target) or is complete enough to publish later (for `draft`).

VersionDiff.description: What changed between two Versions of one Workflow.

patch.description:
An RFC 6902 JSON Patch that turns `from`'s Definition into `to`'s, one operation per
changed field; empty when the Definitions are equal.

definition.description: The Definition as stored, in its canonical JSON form.

VersionSummary.description: A Version without its Definition, as listed.

active.description: Whether this is the Workflow's Active Version.

run_id.description: The Run the request started. It is `pending` until a Worker picks it up.

WebhookBinding.description: The webhook Trigger a `webhook` Token is bound to.

WorkflowInfo.description: A Workflow and the Version new Runs and Schedules use.

active_version.description:
The Published Version new Runs start on and whose Triggers fire. Absent until a Version
is activated.

bootstrap_key.description: The key the server was started with in `BIA_BOOTSTRAP_KEY`.

token.description: A Token, `bia_` and 64 hex digits. Its Scope decides which routes it may call: `admin` everything, `agent` all but publishing, activation and administration, `webhook` only its own webhook Trigger.
